objective: GATE 1 R3 READ_ONLY_SQL para Centro de Control EDARSA y Monitor de Sincronizacion. Ejecutar auditoria canonica contra el HEAD vigente de Edarsahub_Desarrollo sin fijar base_sha para evitar carreras de concurrencia. Obtener evidencia exacta del esquema SQL real para persistencia de alertas/historial/bitacora/metricas, universo de logs de sincronizacion, Servidores_Conexiones, RBAC, scheduler/jobs y Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad. Esta ronda debe ser schema-safe: primero descubrir tablas y columnas reales y no asumir nombres de columnas operativas no verificados. No modificar codigo ni datos. No DDL/DML. No Production. No Mongo. No LIVE.

queries.name: database_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, @@SERVERNAME AS server_name, GETDATE() AS sql_now

queries.name: control_monitor_table_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Centro%Control%' OR t.name LIKE '%Alerta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Bitacora%' OR t.name LIKE '%Historial%' OR t.name LIKE '%Metrica%' OR t.name LIKE '%Health%' OR t.name LIKE '%Monitor%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name

queries.name: control_monitor_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Centro%Control%' OR t.name LIKE '%Alerta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Bitacora%' OR t.name LIKE '%Historial%' OR t.name LIKE '%Metrica%' OR t.name LIKE '%Health%' OR t.name LIKE '%Monitor%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: sync_source_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name IN ('Compras_Sync_Log','Comercial_SyncLog_v2','Sync_Logs','Servidores_Conexiones') OR t.name LIKE '%Sync%Log%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sincron%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name

queries.name: sync_source_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Compras_Sync_Log','Comercial_SyncLog_v2','Sync_Logs','Servidores_Conexiones') OR t.name LIKE '%Sync%Log%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sincron%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: sync_table_row_counts
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,p.rows AS approximate_rows FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE t.name IN ('Compras_Sync_Log','Comercial_SyncLog_v2','Sync_Logs','Servidores_Conexiones') OR t.name LIKE '%Sync%Log%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sincron%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name
